info.title: Hiraman API
info.description: The API behind the Hiraman resident app and the LGU portal. All paths are under /api. Dates are Philippine time (UTC+8). Generated from server/scripts/api-catalog.js by npm run docs:api.

tags.name: community
tags.description: Wanted board, kits, notifications, reports, announcements, impact

get.description: No login needed. Error codes: 503 when the database is down.
